subject.title: [Bug]: Tool JSON Schema patternProperties causes 400 errors on BytePlus Ark (doubao) — schema cleaning should be universal, not provider-specific

question: Should BytePlus/Ark compatibility be fixed with provider-owned modelCompat metadata, or should OpenClaw globally scrub unsupported JSON Schema keywords for non-Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible providers?
rationale: Both approaches can fix the reported 400s, but the global scrubber changes model-facing schemas for many providers and is a compatibility policy decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Provider-Owned Ark Compat
options.body: Add BytePlus/Ark-specific compat metadata or a normalizeResolvedModel hook that strips the proven unsupported keywords for those providers only, then require targeted tests and live Ark proof.

options.title: Global Non-Anthropic Scrubber
options.body: Make schema keyword cleaning the default for non-Anthropic OpenAI-compatible providers, accepting the broader provider compatibility risk as intentional product policy.

options.title: Configurable Opt-In
options.body: Expose or document a strict-schema compat flag/profile so BytePlus users can opt in without changing other providers by default.

recommendation.title: Provider-Owned Ark Compat
recommendation.body: Add BytePlus/Ark-specific compat metadata or a normalizeResolvedModel hook that strips the proven unsupported keywords for those providers only, then require targeted tests and live Ark proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the current schema-normalization package boundary and the bundled provider compat seams.
